name: meltflex
description: AI interior design — restyle rooms, place furniture, and virtually stage spaces from a photo.
long_description: MeltFlex AI turns a room photo into a photorealistic interior redesign, directly from Claude. Restyle rooms, place specific furniture, declutter, and virtually stage interiors, exteriors and gardens. Tools: generate_interior and check_credits. Requires a MeltFlex API key (any active subscription); each generation is billed to your own account credits.

tools.name: generate_interior
tools.description: Restyle or redesign a room from a photo and save the result to disk (10 credits).

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show the account's MeltFlex credit balance and per-operation costs.

api_key.title: MeltFlex API Key
api_key.description: Your mf_sk_ API key from meltflexai.com/settings (requires an active subscription).
